svg.text: Zoom 5 · the state slot: 74 units, one byte span
A's state for the 48 linear layers, laid end to end over its 74 units in step-table order (units 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, …). Each layer takes 3.06 MiB, so
most layers cross a unit boundary.
a layer starts (the number under it is its model layer); shaded band = its bytes; black box = a unit
48 layers × 3.06 MiB = 146.8 MiB → 74 units (the last 1.2 MiB unused). Byte x of the span is in unit state[x / 2 MiB], at x % 2 MiB.
